blogs.title: Beyond the Fourth Time? Feasibility of 'Triple-Stacked' TAVR After Endocarditis
blogs.description: Analyze the rare scenario of a third-generation Transcatheter Heart Valve (THV) implantation (TAV-in-TAV-in-TAV). Discuss why this case breaks new ground by combining multiple previous THVs with a history of Prosthetic Valve Endocarditis (PVE), challenging the traditional dogma that mandates surgical explantation after infected bioprostheses.

blogs.title: High Stakes Planning: Navigating Coronaries in Triple-Layered Anatomy
blogs.description: Focus exclusively on the critical role of advanced MDCT planning in avoiding catastrophic coronary occlusion. Detail the specific metrics evaluated (sinus dimension, neo-skirt formation, valve-to-corporonary distance) and how selecting a high-implant depth and aligning commissures mitigated the risk of blocking coronaries behind three layers of metal struts.

blogs.title: Resolving Prosthesis-Patient Mismatch: The Art of Frame Interaction and Post-Dilation
blogs.description: Examine the immediate hemodynamic paradox where initial post-deployment gradients suggested severe Patient-Prosthesis Mismatch (PPM), yet resolved significantly over one month. Explore the mechanics of high-pressure post-dilation fracturing/expanding older inner frames versus relying solely on leaflet remodeling, offering insights into managing restrictive multilayered stenoses.

blogs.title: Endocarditis vs. Structural Deterioration: When is It Safe to Re-treat Cathetrically?
blogs.description: Discuss the nuanced decision-making algorithm for intervening on a valve previously infected with *Enterococcus*. Contrast ESC/Surgical guidelines recommending SAVR in PVE with this real-world exception where cured status, prohibitive surgical risk, and modern imaging allowed for a successful third transcatheter intervention without recurrent infection.
